packageRules.description: The hk binary (.mise/config.toml, aqua backend) and its pkl schema (hk.pkl, the customManager below) are one version in two files. Grouped so a bump cannot land half-applied: hk 2.x cannot evaluate a 1.x schema.

customManagers.description: hk's pkl schema is pinned by URL inside hk.pkl and no manager parses it. The amends/import keyword stays inside the match so each replaceString occurs once in the file; autoReplaceGlobalMatch then fixes both versions on the line.
